specReferences.heading: 8.5.6 Entering a wave by a quarter turn

produces: Define the along-set and across-set quarter and three-quarter landing cells shared by allemande, do_si_do, and shoulder_round, then route all three operations through that geometry.

conditions: Quarter and three-quarter amounts produce valid, collision-free wave states.
Across and along pair orientations are covered separately.
Whole and half behavior remains unchanged.
